   **Bugs and stability.**

      Review window: May 12, 2026 - Jul 26, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Bence Halász_, Jul 9, 2026, 1/5: "I'm chaning my review from 5 stars to 1 after the recent update. I couldn't agree more with the rest of the reviews here, this app was almost perfect, the best on the market. I've used it for years and now it became a vibecoded trash. The UI is completely changed and looks really awful, previously existing functionalities are missing and on top it became extremely slow (it wasn't fast before either with 10+ years of transaction data). Just awful! Shame on you guys!"
            2. _Quah Ken Loon_, Jul 8, 2026, 1/5: "after update the transaction keyin or amendments very slow to save and record reflect to transaction tab very slow.."
            3. _aloobi_, Jul 26, 2026, 2/5: "Like many apps, it used to be excellent, but after the latest update, it has become frustrating to use. There are numerous glitches, slow processing when entering transactions, and delays when viewing reports. The Travel Mode feature no longer works as it used to. Sometimes it adds all labels, while other times it adds none at all. I contacted the developer. Despite having paid for the app, I didn’t even receive a response."
